title: Fallback to numpy comparison in ArrowExtensionArray.isin for unboxable mixed values
answers: Why does Series.isin raise ArrowTypeError or OverflowError on pyarrow dtypes?
How does ArrowExtensionArray.isin handle mixed-type values that PyArrow cannot box?
Fix ArrowInvalid or OverflowError when calling isin on PyArrow-backed Series
body:
Symptom: Series.isin, DataFrame.isin, or Index.isin on pyarrow dtypes raises ArrowInvalid, ArrowTypeError, or OverflowError when values contains mixed or unboxable types.
Root cause: pandas/core/arrays/arrow/array.py:ArrowExtensionArray.isin delegates directly to pc.is_in after _box_pa, which fails when PyArrow cannot box mixed-type values into a uniform arrow array.
Fix pattern: Catch (pa.ArrowInvalid, pa.ArrowTypeError, OverflowError) on the PyArrow boxing/compute call and fall back to algos.isin on numpy arrays for non-null entries, matching null entries only against missing values in values.
Constraints: Applies to ArrowExtensionArray.isin when values cannot be boxed by pyarrow; missing values (including NaN) in values must match only nulls in the arrow array.
applies: PyArrow-backed extension arrays (ArrowExtensionArray.isin) when passed mixed or incompatible values.
